_comment: Clip A1 (recording_shot_list.md): ground jump in place, forward air dash at the apex (W only on the dash tick), no input after.
Timeline ticks are 1-based sim ticks at 64 Hz and are a first guess: move the dash tick so it matches the trial
(the apex of a 295 u/s jump under 967 u/s^2 is ~0.305 s = tick 20).
fit_window (times from sim tick 0) ends at landing, ~1.04 s: ground friction is not part of this fit.
Alignment: first rising crossing of speed_h through value_u (the air dash start) in video and sim. The jump sits
before t_rel 0 and is not scored; the apex height still enters through pos_v.
B3 trials: set hero to res://data/movement/heroes/hero_heavy_b3.tres (the dash lasts 0.51 s; raise ticks to ~84).
Model comparisons (run each as its own fit and compare cost):
G02 formula: fixed air_dash_end_drag_mode 1 (a), 2 (b), 3 (flat x0.8). G25: fixed air_dash_zero_vertical true / false.
air_dash_end_drag_floor is not fitted: from rest the post-drag speed (~602 u/s) is above the 480 u/s floor, so this
clip cannot see it. Add it only if air_dash_end_drag_frac ends up above ~0.35.
Expected model gap: the real dash ramps up over ~0.13 s (V8 2:10); ours steps. Report that residual under G01, do not tune it away.
Bounds are search limits, not game limits: a result on a bound is flagged in the report.
